Race 1 SPORTSBET JOCKEY WATCH HANDICAP - 1200 metres:

Commit Began awkwardly. Near the 600m was bumped on the hindquarters. When questioned rider Thomas Stockdale explained he had been asked to ride the horse forward. T Stockdale stated after Commit was slow to begin and when several runners held their positions to his inside, as he felt he would have been obliged to cover additional ground without cover, he eased. T Stockdale added he was then able to obtain a trailing position behind American Eagle (eventual winner) where his mount travelled comfortably and had its opportunity to win the race in the straight. Co-trainer Michael Kent Jnr confirmed the plan had been to ride Commit forward, however, after the gelding was slow to begin it settled further back than intended.

Crown Of Fire Knuckled on jumping away.

Corretto Slow to begin. Near the 600m raced in restricted room to the inside of Commit, which after being brushed on the hindquarters shifted in.

American Eagle Got its head up in the early stages when being restrained.

Race 2 MRC MEMBERSHIP MADE OF MOMENTS PLATE - 1600 metres:

Gold Chariot (NZ) Change of tactics To be ridden further back. Began awkwardly and settled towards the rear of the field. When racing keenly near the 1400m was steadied from the heels of Everymomentcounts. Rider Jett Stanley reported, as notified, he was asked to ride the horse further back. J Stanley stated in accordance with the instructions he eased and settled towards the rear where Gold Chariot over raced in the early stages. J Stanely added he was not disappointed in the gelding's performance as he felt the tempo of the race was not conducive to horses making ground from back in the field.

Everymomentcounts Raced three wide without cover. Raced keenly in the middle stages.

Zareenee Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

Chateau Dancer Near the 1200m was steadied when crowded for room by Tornado Anwa (John Keating), which shifted in. Held up from the 500m before shifting out to obtain clear running passing the 400m. Rider Luke Nolen reported the mare would be better suited in races over a longer distance.

Rider John Keating (Tornado Anwa) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding under the provisions of AR131(a), in that near the 1200m he permitted his mount to shift in when not sufficiently clear of Chateau Dancer, which was steadied when crowded for room. J Keating had his licence to ride in races suspended for a total of 8 race meetings, with the period to commence on Thursday 16 July 2026 and to expire on Thursday 23 July 2026. Accordingly, J Keating will be able to return to ride on Friday 24 July 2026. In assessing penalty, account was taken of his guilty plea, record and that the incident was in the low-range category.

Race 3 SPORTSBET RACE REPLAYS HANDICAP - 1400 metres:

Tempranillo Change of tactics To be ridden more forward. Settled outside the leader.

Everett Slow to begin.

Meh Keffi Near the 1200m was inconvenienced by Silent Shares, which was taken in slightly by Delicate Lady, which shifted in before being straightened by rider Luke Cartwright. L Cartwright was notified to exercise more care in similar circumstances.

Sea Poem (NZ) Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Rider Craig Williams reported the mare did not handle today's heavy track conditions.

Silent Shares Raced three wide without cover.

Delicate Lady Apprentice Luke Cartwright and trainer Jerome Hunter were of the view that Delicate Lady did not run out the distance of today's race and would be better suited over shorter journeys. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the mare to be lame in the right fore and have a throat condition. A veterinary clearance is required prior to being permitted to race again or officially trial.

Brutalina Rider Jamie Mott reported his mount did not handle today's heavy track conditions, although when weakening in the straight he felt there may be something amiss with the mare. A post-race veterinary examination did not identify any significant abnormal findings. Stewards will follow up with the stable.

Race 4 TOBIN BROTHERS CELEBRATING LIVES HANDICAP - 1000 metres:

Ravenclaw Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination due to not racing since September 2025 after having a pedal bone injury and was passed suitable to race. Apprentice Emily Pozman reported the gelding, which was resuming from a lengthy spell and on today's heavy track, tired over the latter stages and would derive fitness benefit from today's race. A post-race veterinary examination did not identify any significant abnormal findings.

Weapon Clear Began awkwardly.

Legacy Bel Began awkwardly.

Bella Cinque - Began awkwardly.

Misty Legend Near the 600m was eased when tightened for room by Dreamzel (App Jackson Radley), which shifted in. J Radley was reprimanded and notified to exercise more care. A post-race veterinary examination at the request of the stable did not identify any significant abnormal findings.

Race 5 SPORTSBET FEED HANDICAP - 1000 metres:

Longreach Drover Late scratching at 12.14pm by Order of Stewards after trainer Frankie Stockdale advised he was experiencing transport issues.

Bliss Bomb Trainer Lloyd Kennewell was fined $200 for failing to produce the ID Card for the filly AR65(1).

Our Wynd Chymes Knuckled on jumping away. Rider John Allen reported the filly failed to travel at any stage throughout the event. A post-race veterinary examination did not identify any significant abnormal findings. Stewards will follow up with the stable.

Obucci Began awkwardly.

Blue Humma Held up for clear running from the 400m to the 300m. When questioned rider Jamie Mott explained in the early part of the straight, when racing behind Saluted and Bold Suitor, he had hoped to shift to the outside of those horses where he felt the ground was superior. J Mott added, however, passing the 400m when held up and as there appeared an opening would not eventuate to his outside, he took the opportunity to shift back to the inside of Saluted near the 300m where Blue Humma initially responded well, however, over the latter stages tired and he felt the gelding was not entirely comfortable under pressure in the heavy track conditions.

Satin Diva A post-race veterinary examination revealed the filly to be lame in the right hind. A veterinary clearance is required prior to being permitted to race again or officially trial.

Race 6 EVERGREEN TURF HANDICAP - 1800 metres:

Holmes Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed suitable to race. Laid out under pressure in the early part of the straight. A post-race veterinary examination did not identify any significant abnormal findings.

Icaro Slow to begin.

Blue Willow Slow to begin.

Imponderable Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Rider Damien Thornton reported his mount raced too keenly and as a result did not finish the race off as expected. A post-race endoscopic examination identified a degree of mucus that may have affected the horses racing performance. A veterinary clearance is required prior to being permitted to race again or officially trial again.

Race 7 THOROUGHBRED CLUB OF AUSTRALIA HANDICAP - 2400 metres:

Miss Niagara (NZ) Began awkwardly.

Shultzy Slow to begin.

Jaykayann (NZ) Blundered in the going near the 500m.

Empress Of The Sun (JPN) When questioned apprentice Jabez Johnstone explained he was able to obtain a comfortable lead throughout the early and middle stages, however, from the 1000m he felt Empress Of The Sun hit a flat spot on the heavy track and he was reluctant to place too much pressure on his mount that far from the finish. J Johnstone added from the 800m Empress Of The Sun commenced to travel better. J Johnstone was fined $300 for breaching the provisions of AR132(7)(a)(ii) in that he used his whip on nine occasions prior to the 100 metres, which is four more than permitted.

Flying Witness - Trainer Brett Scott advised that the intention would be to have the gelding's next start in a jumping event.

Race 8 SPORTSBET SAME RACE MULTI HANDICAP - 1400 metres:

Currawood (IRE) (First start in Australia) Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination due to not racing since June 2025 and was passed suitable to race. Slow to begin.

Outta Compton Change of tactics To be ridden further back from the wide barrier. Settled at the rear of the field.

Botanical Boy Began awkwardly. Laid out when placed under pressure near the 300m.

Supernima Near the 1000m got its head up when being steadied from the heels of Currawood, which had commenced to ease. Apprentice Luke Cartwright reported his mount did not handle today's heavy track conditions. A post-race veterinary examination did not identify any significant abnormal findings.

He'll Rip Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 900m was eased from the heels of Kahhof.

Supplementary Report

Warrnambool Sunday 14 June 2026

Race 4 PONTINGS MITRE 10 OPEN STEEPLECHASE - 3450 metres:

Stewards today concluded an inquiry, previously adjourned from the Warrnambool race meeting 14 June 2026, following the running of race four where Not Usual Dream (NZ) fell. The inquiry was originally adjourned as jockey Arron Lynch (Not Usual Dream (NZ)) was injured and has only recently been medically cleared to participate in a Stewards inquiry.

Steven Pateman rider of The Might Spar (NZ) was found guilty of a charge of careless riding under the provisions of AR 131 (a) that states:

AR 131 Riding offences

A rider must not, in the opinion of the Stewards:

(a)                 engage in careless, reckless, improper, incompetent or foul riding;

The particulars of the charge being approaching the 18th obstacle near the 600m, Steven Pateman rode The Mighty Spar (NZ) in, when not sufficiently clear of Not Usual Dream (NZ), resulting in Not Usual Dream (NZ) checking, losing its rightful running and falling at the 18th obstacle.

Steven Pateman had his license to ride in races suspended for a total of 16 jumps / highweight races, with the period to commence on Monday 20 July 2026 and to expire on Sunday 16 August 2026. Accordingly, Steven Pateman will be able to return to ride on Monday 17 August 2026. In assessing penalty, account was taken of his record, nature of the incident resulting in a fall and jockey Arron Lynch sustaining injuries and that safety is paramount.
